title: Sell to dealers
headline: Sell to *dealers*
sub: A price list, an offer, and a deal within your limits.

bridge.en: A big deal, orders, money, a team. How does Ikenna see it all first thing in the morning?
bridge.pcm: Big deal, orders, money, team. How Ikenna go see everything for morning?

flow.action: Taps a pen twice on a small notebook, looks up, tilts her head with one brow raised and a knowing half-smile
flow.setting: a bright market-street phone shop in Ibadan: phones on a back-lit shelf, a counter with a cash box, a rusted corrugated roof outside
flow.camera: medium close-up, locked-off, shallow depth of field

flow.action: Reads his phone, gives a firm nod, then breaks into a wide grin
flow.setting: Techline Gadgets in Computer Village, Ikeja: a narrow shop with a glass display counter, shelves of plain unbranded phone boxes, a wall of chargers and cables on hooks, warm bulbs, a roll-up shutter
